states.created: session.json exists, but no run has been prepared.
states.prepared: prepare() recorded a start condition and optional readiness gate.
states.running: start.json was published and clients may begin work.
states.closed: stop.json was published and active run state was cleaned.
states.cancelled: cancel.json was published and active run state was cleaned.

write_gates.start_signal: Clients must not begin work until start.json exists.
write_gates.ready_active_reports: ready and active reports are rejected after stop.json or cancel.json exists.
write_gates.done_reports: done reports remain allowed after stop so clients can report graceful completion.
